behaviour-switch.answer: The switch is DialectBehavior.CompileTimeArithmeticImplementorDefined (src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Runtime/Control/DialectBehavior.cs:301), read only by CompileTimeArithmetic.For (src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Frontend/Expressions/CompileTimeArithmetic.cs:44), which picks the mode for operand entry and + - * / inside a compile-time arithmetic expression (§2002:7.2.5.2 GR1; its 34-digit 2002 mode against §2002:8.8.1.3.1.1's 32 digits is the known PB5575-family defect, reaching only results of arithmetic operations). The rule refuses three literal forms in a directive; that is decided on the literal's form, apart from any arithmetic operation. Re-run now at --std 2002: d_lit_cat, d_lit_fig, d_lit_float, e_if_fig, e_if_float refused (COBOL1619, each naming SR10), d_lit_ok.cob prints OK (E:\COBOL-coord\scratch\op-20261114\read-2002\out-answer\probes-a-03\run-q01-2002.log).
